title: Career highlights: Oscar, Ray and being used on others' records
summary: Highlights were the Peterson trio and JATP; other players often used him on their own records.

story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: You’ve played with so many of the great, great people in jazz, and so many have played with you. Is there, in your career, what are the highlights for you? Have we already mentioned them?

Hmmm. Highlights. I think certainly playing with Oscar and Ray was a highlight. And then playing with all the other people in Jazz at the Philharmonic. And what was a great reward for me and great confidence builder, almost all the ones when they’d make their own records they’d use me.
Yes it really is. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
